title: ঐগ লেপসি অমদগি তুলা | Ten Little Bananas Manipuri Kids Song | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A fun Manipuri nursery rhyme where ten yellow bananas disappear one by one, but a cheeky squirrel learns a lesson about sharing.
Little ones count from one to ten while singing along with this warm, playful song.
Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers learning numbers, sharing, and saying sorry.
